metadata.description: Make the Claude Pro plan last longer: exact usage HUD, a per-turn session receipt, a context breakdown, a usage limit guard, fewer tools loaded per request, shorter shell output, capped and repeat file reads, a prompt-cache countdown, update notices. The mods spend no tokens themselves.

plugins.name: pro-hud
plugins.description: Desktop heads-up display: live session, week and context meters, per-turn token receipt, usage in the spinner, compact tool rows.

plugins.name: output-diet
plugins.description: Trims long shell output before Claude reads it (head, tail and error lines kept); the untrimmed text is saved to a file Claude can open.

plugins.name: turn-budget
plugins.description: Asks before one turn uses more than +5 session points or 500,000 uncached input tokens, and stops it cleanly if you say so.

plugins.name: tool-diet
plugins.description: Loads tools you have not used lately on demand through ToolSearch instead of with every request; core tools and recently used ones stay loaded.

plugins.name: context-xray
plugins.description: /xray opens a pane with the exact breakdown of what fills the context window and which tools load on every request.

plugins.name: reread-guard
plugins.description: Skips Claude's identical re-read of a file that has not changed; a deliberate retry still goes through.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Status line countdown until the prompt cache expires; once it has, the exact tokens your next message re-sends uncached.

plugins.name: read-cap
plugins.description: Stops a whole-file read of a file over 1,000 lines once and gives Claude an outline tool so it reads only the range it needs.

plugins.name: session-receipt
plugins.description: /receipt opens a pane with the exact tokens every turn of the session spent and the costliest turns.

plugins.name: budget-guard
plugins.description: Holds a prompt back once your 5-hour or weekly usage is at or over your limit (90% by default); sending it again goes through.

plugins.name: kit-updates
plugins.description: Tells you when an installed claude-pro-kit mod has a newer version or a new mod joins the kit; /kit-update installs updates.

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another chat on this machine changed in the last 30 minutes.
